'''John Anderson''' (1982–2018; forum handle '''puck71''', call sign "Puck 71") was a Star Wars CCG player and volunteer in the Minnesota and North Dakota community.<ref name="cardlabels" /><ref name="ja-announce" /><ref name="ja-stamp">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1270397#p1270397 Willing to trade for/buy John Anderson stamped Overseer: the stamp], Players Committee forum (Shadow 14, 27 August 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052311/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1270397.html Internet Archive]</ref> He organized the North Dakota State Championship in Fargo from 2010 to 2018<ref name="ja-nd2010">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=507879#p507879 2010 North Dakota States - May 22, 2010], Players Committee forum (puck71, 31 January 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052814/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p507879.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ja-nd2018">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1184107#p1184107 2018 North Dakota States - Fargo, ND - August 4], Players Committee forum (puck71, 27 April 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125053024/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1184107.html Internet Archive]</ref> and played eight [[World Championships|World Championships]] between 2008 and 2016, as well as Match Play Championships, US Nationals and Bespin regional events. His last listed event is the [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]], where he finished 27th.<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ 2018 Endor Grand Prix], starwarsccg.org</ref> He died in 2018 after an illness; players gave to leukemia research in his name, and part of his treatment had been at the University of Minnesota.<ref name="cardlabels" /><ref name="ja-donate" /><ref name="ja-khurgee">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1270622#p1270622 3 Additional Virtual Cards from John Anderson Memorial Tournament], Players Committee forum (fungineer, 27 August 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052451/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1270622.html Internet Archive]</ref> The community honored him with the John Anderson Memorial Tournament, the [[2019 North American Continental Championship]] in Minnesota, and with memorial cards, a baseball outing and an annual volunteer award. From 2001 to 2004 he played in the Atlanta area of Georgia, where he was the tournament director of the [[2003 Georgia State Championship]] and announced tournaments at T & T Toys in Duluth; see [[#Atlanta area, 2001–2004|Atlanta area, 2001–2004]].<ref name="pc-us03" /><ref name="pcf-3247-45800" /> {{Mystery|question=Are the Atlanta player of 2001–2004 and the Minnesota and North Dakota player the same John Anderson|section=John Anderson of Atlanta and John Anderson of Minnesota: one person or two?|type=people}}

== Atlanta area, 2001–2004 ==

On [[DeckTech]] he signed his tournament reports as John "Shadow 29" Anderson (2001) and John "Alpha Blue" Anderson (2001–2002).<ref name="tr-d2888" /><ref name="tr-d3085" /><ref name="tr-d3244" /> On the [[Players Committee]] forum he posted as Shadow 29; his forum signature (captured March 2004) read "Squadron Member- "Shadow 29"", "The Mad Scientist" and "ATL Senate".<ref name="pcf-2224-39292">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39292#39292 Georgia Tourneys], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318153120/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40240%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The Shadow 29 signature was already on his posts in July 2003.<ref name="pcf-1940-30800">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30800#30800 "Ancient" Decks..], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (21 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040323101549/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1940%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

He was the tournament director of the [[2003 Georgia State Championship]], held at T & T Toys in Duluth, Georgia, on 17 May 2003.<ref name="pc-us03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref> Duluth is about 15 minutes northeast of Atlanta on I-85, and the store was inside a mall there.<ref name="pcf-3211-45478">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45478#45478 Looking for players in GA, particularly Augusta and Atlanta], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 April 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040627213856/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3211%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In September 2003 he announced two four-game tournaments at T & T for 3 and 25 October 2003, both at noon, with a $5 entry fee only for players who wanted prize support.<ref name="pcf-2224-33712">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=33712#33712 Georgia Tourneys], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 September 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041105060741/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=33797%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In January 2004 he posted the schedule of the [[2004 DPC Atlanta|DPC weekend]] at T & T on 20–22 February 2004.<ref name="pcf-2224-39429">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39429#39429 Georgia Tourneys], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318153120/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40240%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In April 2004 he wrote that T & T held tournaments on the first and third Saturdays of every month, [[Classic]] on the first and [[Open]] on the third, with a $5 entry fee, store credit for the top four and packs of Star Wars CCG for everyone else.<ref name="pcf-2224-45358">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45358#45358 Georgia Tourneys], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 April 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040518230111/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44893%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> On 2 May 2004 he announced the [[2004 Georgia State Championship]], to be held at T & T on 22 May 2004.<ref name="pcf-3247-45800">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=45800#45800 GA States], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 May 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021935/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=46766%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

In June 2004 he gave his record with a Light Side Senate deck as 2–2 at [[Gen Con 2003]], 1–2 at "Day 1" and 0–3 at Georgia States.<ref name="pcf-3428-47308">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47308#47308 2004 Tennessee State Championship], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212621/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In August 2004, after playing the [[2004 Georgia State Championship]] without qualifying and missing the [[2004 Tennessee State Championship|Tennessee]] and [[2004 Florida State Championship|Florida]] State Championships, he planned to play Day 1 of the [[2004 World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-3797-51876">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51876#51876 Day 1], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041105141844/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52779%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Card credits ==
John Anderson is credited with the original concept of two Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> Two Virtual Premium cards carry an "In memory of" dedication to John Anderson.<ref name="cardlabels" /> The concept credit names where the concept was won: [[2011 US Nationals|US Nationals 2011]]. The cards are in [[Virtual Block 9]] (released 2014) and Virtual Premium.

== Memorial ==

In October 2018 players collected donations for a gift to a leukemia charity in John's name, to pass to his family in time for his funeral services; the [[Players Committee]] matched the first $500, making a $1,000 gift. Because part of his treatment had been at the University of Minnesota, players proposed the university's leukemia and lymphoma research fund for the gift.<ref name="ja-donate">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1222693#p1222693 Donations for John], Players Committee forum (gogolen, 7 and 8 October 2018; jimli and Yoshi, 8–9 October 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052532/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1222693.html Internet Archive]</ref>

=== John Anderson Memorial Tournament ===
The Players Committee held the [[2019 North American Continental Championship]] in his memory as the John Anderson Memorial Continental Tournament. It was the North American alternative for players who could not travel to the European [[2019 World Championship]]. The organizers chose Minnesota to be near the Rosemount school program he cared for and near his friends and family, describing him as someone who "was always quick to volunteer".<ref name="ja-announce">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1245707#p1245707 Announcing the John Anderson Memorial Continental Tournament], Players Committee forum (imrahil327, 28 February 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125051458/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1245707.html Internet Archive]</ref> The event ran 23–25 August 2019 at the Hyatt Regency in Bloomington, Minnesota.<ref name="ja-hotel">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1245708#p1245708 Hotel Information], Players Committee forum (imrahil327, 28 February 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125051959/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1245708.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ja-sched">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1259062#p1259062 Event Schedule details], Players Committee forum (gogolen, 8 June 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052008/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1259062.html Internet Archive]</ref> Every participant received a John Anderson Continentals pin and lanyard.<ref name="ja-prereg">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1259061#p1259061 Pre-registration Now Available], Players Committee forum (gogolen, 8 June 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052108/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1259061.html Internet Archive]</ref> Members of his family attended the opening and thanked the community for honoring him.<ref name="ja-family">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1271192#p1271192 Announcing the John Anderson Memorial Continental Tournament (message from the Anderson family)], Players Committee forum (gogolen, 30 August 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125051458/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1245707.html Internet Archive]</ref>

=== Twins game and scoreboard tribute ===
In place of the usual Friday team tournament, and in honor of his baseball fandom, the organizers bought a block of tickets to the Minnesota Twins vs. Detroit Tigers game at Target Field on Friday 23 August 2019. [[Garrett Larson]] found a donor to put a message dedicated to John on the scoreboard.<ref name="ja-twins">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1254753#p1254753 Tigers @ Twins, 8/23 (Group Outing Friday)], Players Committee forum (imrahil327, 3 May 2019).</ref> The group had 36 tickets across two sections.<ref name="ja-logistics">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1269624#p1269624 Friday Night Baseball Game Logistics Thread], Players Committee forum (imrahil327, 22 August 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125051809/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1269765.html Internet Archive]</ref> The team's official picture of the scoreboard message went to John's family.<ref name="ja-official">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1272925#p1272925 Tigers @ Twins, 8/23 (Group Outing Friday): official scoreboard picture], Players Committee forum (imrahil327, 17 September 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125053125/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1272925.html Internet Archive]</ref>

=== Memorial boosters and cards ===
John donated his card collection to the community. At the memorial tournament, booster packs each held one card from his collection, heat-foil stamped in gold with a "P71" logo and his name: the Players Committee promo "P" with a small "71" for his call sign. [[Kevin Jaap]] made the stamping possible.<ref name="ja-cards">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1270423#p1270423 Release of 3 Premium Virtual Cards at the John Anderson Memorial Tournament], Players Committee forum (DesignAdvocate, 27 August 2019). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052249/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1270423.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ja-stamp" /> The same packs held three Virtual cards made for him: [[Captain Khurgee (V)|•Captain Khurgee (V)]], his own card design, finished before [[Virtual Set 10]] but held back for this event, and [[Puck|•Puck]] and his X-wing [[Red 12|•Red&nbsp;12]], which print "In memory of John Anderson, 1982 - 2018". Puck's destiny of 7 or 1 reads as 71.<ref name="ja-cards" /><ref name="ja-khurgee" /><ref name="cardlabels" /> The three cards were legal for the [[2019 World Championship]].<ref name="ja-cards" />

=== John Anderson Volunteer of the Year Award ===
Since 2021 the Players Committee's advocates have presented the John Anderson Volunteer of the Year Award alongside the advocate awards. The 2021 award went to [[Adam Fletcher]].<ref name="ja-award">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1362686#p1362686 Congratulations to the 2021 Advocate Volunteer Award Winners!], Players Committee forum (Jnapolit31, 10 December 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125052625/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1362686.html Internet Archive]</ref> The 2022 award went to [[Christian Knudsen]].<ref name="slack-va22">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Jared Napolitano (JaredNap), 16 December 2022: “Congratulations to the 2022 John Anderson Volunteer of the Year: Christian Knudsen @chrknudsen”.</ref> See [[Hall of Fame]].
